title: Create a full VTT product scope map: what's decided, what's open, and what's not yet discussed at all, across every subsystem, not just map/terrain
objective: Owner-directed: after mapping the map/terrain construction system thoroughly (docs/research/vtt-map-and-terrain-construction-options.md), the owner asked to zoom out and map every point of the whole VTT product -- what has been discussed, what has not, and the main points needed for a genuinely good VTT that could also be reused for other purposes. This is a coverage map / gap analysis, not new deep research per topic: it creates a new document, docs/research/vtt-product-scope-map.md, organizing the full product surface into categories (map/world, tokens/characters/combat, game-system/rules engine, multiplayer/networking, GM tools, player tools, content-creation/asset-pipeline/marketplace, platform/deployment, cross-project reusability), marking each as Decided/Standby/Open/Not-discussed with a pointer to existing detail where it exists, so the owner can see the full picture and choose what to tackle next deliberately rather than discovering gaps ad hoc. Explicitly flags multiplayer/networking (real-time state-sync transport for the already-built Command/DomainEvent engine across multiple clients) as the most foundational not-yet-discussed gap, since every construction tier and every other subsystem eventually depends on some sync/transport answer -- stated as a structural observation, not a decision made on the owner's behalf.
validations: Created docs/research/vtt-product-scope-map.md with the same non-normative research-catalog framing as its sibling documents (Decision authority: none, dated facts will drift).

Covered nine categories: Map & World (cross-referencing the existing detailed document rather than duplicating it), Tokens/Characters/Combat, Game System/Rules Engine (flagging the system-agnostic-vs-single-system fork as a real open decision), Multiplayer & Networking (flagged as the most foundational not-yet-discussed gap), GM Tools, Player Tools, Content Creation/Asset Pipeline/Marketplace, Platform & Deployment, and Cross-project Reusability (distinguishing what's already designed to be reusable beyond the VTT -- Isekai/Wasm bridge, domain-core, the procedural-generation crates -- from what's VTT-specific and would need a real boundary per DEC-049/ADR-0011 if ever reused).

Did not perform new deep research on any 'Not discussed' item in this pass -- this is explicitly a map of coverage, not a research pass on every empty cell; each flagged gap remains a candidate for its own future research/task.
Cross-referenced this new document from docs/research/vtt-map-and-terrain-construction-options.md's scope note.

Checked docs/research/RESEARCH-DECISIONS-REGISTRY.md: no new tool/candidate adoption decisions were made in this pass (this is a scope/coverage map, not a tool comparison), so no registry rows were added -- confirmed by re-reading the registry's purpose (tool-adoption index, not product-scope tracking).
risks: This is a coverage map only -- most cells are explicitly 'Open' or 'Not discussed,' meaning most of the VTT's actual design work remains to be done in future sessions.
No dependency installed, no code written, no ADR reopened -- documentation only.
